findings: Prior blocker confirmed resolved by existing code: verify_cell_sources in the now-supplied orchestrator/colab_patient.py refuses trailing/duplicate runs (run index >= len(sources) -> 'executed source not bound'), runs of pre-existing or unbound cells (code map and includeOutputs=false readback must both equal the packet source for that index), and missing runs ('execution sequence incomplete'). setup.verify_transcript invokes it before any stream parsing, so all three refusals hold without duplicated logic; the new regressions exercise the imported guard.

New guards verified in source: at most one __open_colab_browser_connection (SETUP_CONNECTION_REOPEN_REFUSED); setup stream bounded to 4096 bytes with ast.literal_eval parse failures classified as SETUP_TRANSPORT_OUTPUT_SCHEMA; environment stream bounded to 132096 bytes with strict schema/binding validation; mode-required CLI arguments enforced via parser.error; umask 0o077 with exclusive-create and chmod 0600 on all persistent artifacts.

Fail-closed and authority preservation verified: frozen_sources re-checks snapshot HEAD==EXECUTION_PIN, clean/no-remote state, frozen import-closure bytes, the 465a0c3b frozen review via an isolated (-I) subprocess, pinned requirements bytes and capture-wrapper module bytes at both prepare and verify time; environment cell re-runs check_observation(source_absent=False) requiring matches_expected on all frozen rows and absent prediction paths; claim_setup exclusive intent plus setup_root/fingerprint binding prevents retry and parallel duplicate setups; scientific_acceptance and patient_launch_authorized remain False in every artifact; the reviewed 7z apt lines are byte-bound to PREPARATION_PIN AST constants.

Suggestion (non-blocking): check_observation passes vacuously when frozen_rows is empty. setup.packet() validates the receipt hash against the rebuilt prior packet and runs intake.validate_fields, but does not re-check the observation's source_files paths against the prior request the way intake.verify_transcript did before writing the receipt, so a tampered local receipt file could yield zero frozen_rows. Remote cells are unaffected (paths derive from the bound runtime_request). Require nonempty frozen_rows or re-check the path binding.

Suggestion (non-blocking): setup_root embeds the literal '0770c7dcabe7' instead of deriving intake.EXECUTION_PIN[:12]; it would silently go stale if the execution pin changed. Similarly cosmetic: claim_setup.absent() raises an uncaught FileNotFoundError when a fixed parent is missing, and a run_code_cell event lacking a tool_result raises KeyError during verification — both fail closed but without classified error names.
